::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 6th [1877]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas, Austin
:::

[Sir](people/person_712.qmd)
I was obliged to let your letter wait till my return as I could not reply without referring to the book.[^1]

‘The Second Temple’ is an anonymous poem in a collection called the Casket made by Joanna Baillie some 50 years ago

_______________________________________________________________________

Moses
[Cardinal Newman](people/person_1084.qmd) - in the [Lyra Apostolica](other_books/otherbook_92.qmd)

_______________________________________________________________________

Seventh Sunday after Trinity-
Keble - [Lyra Innocentium](other_books/otherbook_232.qmd)

________________________________________________________________________

3d Sunday in Advent
[Mrs Yonge](people/person_1606.qmd)

________________________________________________________________________

Good Friday
Come to a desert place
Wednesday in holy week
[Professor Anstice](people/person_2285.qmd)

________________________________________________________________________

22d after Trinity
St John the Evangelist
Epiphany
Whitsunday
from [Translations of hymns from the Paris Breviary](other_books/otherbook_823.qmd) by the Revd [Isaac Williams](people/person_1523.qmd)

________________________________________________________________________

yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: Horder, who published several anthologies of hymns, had evidently asked CMY to identify the contributors to *The Child's Christian Year*, a volume compiled by her mother.
